- [List spend records](https://docs.northbeam.io/reference/get_spend.md): Retrieve daily spend records for a platform and date range.
- [Upsert one or multiple spend records](https://docs.northbeam.io/reference/post_spend.md): Create or update daily spend records. Records are matched on platform and the campaign/adset/ad hierarchy plus date; existing records with the same key are overwritten. Batches of up to 1000 per call.
- [Delete a spend record](https://docs.northbeam.io/reference/delete_spend.md): Delete a previously submitted daily spend record, matched on platform and the campaign/adset/ad hierarchy plus date.

- [Upsert one or multiple hourly spend records](https://docs.northbeam.io/reference/post_spend-hourly.md): Create or update hourly spend records. Same matching behavior as the daily endpoint, at hourly granularity. Batches of up to 1000 per call.
- [Delete a spend record (hourly)](https://docs.northbeam.io/reference/delete_spend-hourly.md): Delete a previously submitted hourly spend record. Same matching behavior as the daily endpoint, at hourly granularity.
